purpose: First local latest-version observation only; not historical PIT or trading
preconditions: Confirm stock/date candidate and applicable trading calendar
Confirm PriceAdj access without exposing credentials in chat
Use approved runtime credential handling and existing one-shot execution gates
Record actual request start, response completion and HTTP status
Validate exact scope, provider status, row count, numeric fields and warnings before saving
stop_conditions: Missing precondition or runtime execution authorization
Empty data or more than one observation
Wrong stock/date, duplicates, invalid fields or response size exceeded
Unknown timezone or invalid time order
Unexpected response shape; no automatic retry
limitations: Observation times describe present acquisition, not availability on 2026-10-07
No provider revision or historical publication time will be invented
Content scope checks do not close C06/C07/C10/C12 evidence gaps
Price zero warnings require separate review even if raw snapshot is retained
